description: Immutable SQL result and host rerank prefetch; supported cuVS selector probes

method.sql_only_pairs: Four 60-second broad-filter runs, alternating SQL lookahead 0/4 with worker prefetch disabled
method.direct_caveat: Same distributions, different query/filter pairings; excludes SQL/MVCC
method.limits: One sustained main pass per setting/filter; two alternating SQL-only pairs. Synthetic warm RAM workload.

selector_probe.api: cuVS 26.10 C++ select_k, single matrix row, int64 positions
selector_probe.input: Seeded uniform float32 scores with some +infinity entries
selector_probe.timing: 300 repeated calls; CUDA events; ten warmups
selector_probe.reason: These installed warp selectors reject requested k=756; WarpAuto reports maximum k=256
selector_probe.validation: Unique in-range positions, correct threshold and matching selected values for supported algorithms
selector_probe.limits: Standalone microtest, not a production query benchmark; no real-score or batched-selector conclusion
